title: Document Outline and Collapsible Sections
selected_by_owner: 2026-10-03 owner explicitly directed continued implementation and asked to proceed efficiently through the remaining writing-system work without reopening settled process/design decisions.
objective: Add the shared document outline and collapsible-section authoring layer on top of the published CreatorDocumentEditor: derive an arbitrary-depth heading tree, jump from outline entries to document headings, collapse/expand heading subtrees as view state only, and reorder a heading together with its full descendant section without corrupting canonical node identity.

include: derived arbitrary-depth heading outline from CreatorDocumentV1
stable nodeId-based outline entries and editor jump/focus behavior
accessible expand/collapse controls for heading sections
collapse state kept outside persisted CreatorDocumentV1 content
heading-subtree range calculation and deterministic section reorder
drag/reorder behavior with keyboard-accessible command equivalents
outline/editor synchronization after edits and external document replacement
focused CWKS-04 tests, styling hooks, and Linux/Windows deterministic validation
exclude: story project hierarchy, corkboard, storyboard, timeline or plot board
changes to GPR Session Service scope
